events.title: FAMILY KARAOKE
events.description: If you’ve been hunting for family karaoke on the coast that doesn’t take itself too seriously, you’ve found it. Beer Garden Belters is your monthly excuse to grab the fam, a mic, butcher a classic, or absolutely nail it - all in the laid-back chaos of the Banana Bender beer garden. Kids, parents, mates… everyone’s welcome

events.title: TRIBUTE FESTIVAL 26′
events.description:
The Ultimate Tribute Festival '26 

Get ready for a night of unforgettable music, Friday, Sep 25th, six top tribute acts one epic show.

A night of timeless hits of ABBA, Bee Gees, Neil Diamond, Barbra Streisand, Creedence Clearwater Revival, Fleetwood Mac Experience in a non-stop celebration of classic anthems. Music that shapped generations. – each delivering a 40 min set of iconic hits.

events.title: BINGO LOCO
events.description:
Bingo Loco: a wild 3-hour show with rave rounds, dance-offs, epic prizes & nonstop energy. Saturday 26th September.
PALMVIEW!!! Strap yourselves, in because the world's LARGEST BINGO RAVE is heading to the Bender for a massive event! Grab your tickets now,

events.title: JUNIOR OPEN MIC NIGHT SEPTEMBER
events.description: The Banana Bender is all about backing fresh talent, and this year we’re giving the juniors the entire stage to themselves. Back after a popular demand - Friday 10th July from 3-10pm. Bring your instruments and your cheer squad. Full backline supplied thanks to Mooloolaba Music
